name: React to task mentions
description: Runs an agent on the task whenever it is @-mentioned in the task or a comment.

de.name: Auf Aufgaben-Erwähnungen reagieren
de.description: Startet einen Agenten auf der Aufgabe, sobald er dort oder in einem Kommentar @-erwähnt wird.

fr.name: Réagir aux mentions dans les tâches
fr.description: Lance un agent sur la tâche dès qu'il est mentionné avec @ dans la tâche ou un commentaire.

config.description: Writes by the automation engine itself (nudges, rollups, failure notes, engine-created tasks) are inert by design — only human- and agent-authored mentions trigger runs. This is loop-safety invariant (iii).
Human mentions are plain notifications (handled by the collab layer). An agent can never trigger itself.

parameters.instructions: You were @-mentioned on this task — in a comment or in the task description (the mentioning text is in the trigger context below). Read it, do what it asks of you using your task tools, and post your reply as a task comment. If it asks something outside your abilities, reply with a comment saying so precisely. If the request conflicts with your working agreement, decline politely in a comment.

config.expression: steps.respond.output.data.ok == true && steps.respond.output.data.steered != true && steps.respond.output.data.external != true && steps.fetch_task.output.data.task.assigneeType == 'agent' && steps.fetch_task.output.data.task.assigneeId == loop.item.id && (steps.fetch_task.output.data.task.status == 'todo' || steps.fetch_task.output.data.task.status == 'in_progress')
config.description: A mention is conversation by default and never moves the board. The one exception: the mentioned agent IS the task's assignee (the mention is a retry/continue of its assigned work) and its run succeeded in-platform — park the task at In review exactly like run-assigned does, so a successful mention-retry closes the assignment loop instead of stranding the task. In progress counts because run admission acks the assignee-mention run In progress (ackRunInProgress); done/cancelled/already-in-review and external dispatches stay untouched. A STEERED result (the mention was injected into an already-running run on this task) is not a completed run — the live run owns the choreography, so skip.

Roll back ONLY what the admission ack moved: an ADMITTED run (a run row exists — `runId`) by the task's own assignee that failed and left the task In progress. Refusals never touched the status (no ack pre-admission, #2604) and non-assignee mentions never ack, so both fall through quietly.

parameters.body: [automated] ⚠️ {{loop.item.id}} could not complete this task: {{steps.respond.output.data.error || 'unknown error'}} — returned to To do.
